note: P4135 (Pro 20:12) — the hearing ear and the seeing eye, the LORD has made them both.

dims.v: hearing — the faculty of attention, God-given
the hearing ear — the faculty of attentive hearing that the LORD himself has made
the God-given faculty of perception, implying accountability for its use

shama (hear) — 'the HEARING ear and the seeing eye, the LORD has made them both'; the faculties of perception are God's gift. The read hears the implication — since God made the ear to hear and the eye to see, we are accountable for what we hear and see. Perception is a divine trust.
